action.permissions.reason: extension dialogs are generic user input, not permissions

action.tools.reason: observed tool lifecycle only; no portable catalog

capabilities.reason: conservative descriptor synthesized for the pinned RPC vocabulary

protocol.initialize.reason: Pi has no negotiation; readiness is a get_state handshake

run.cancel.reason: abort intent is local; agent_settled remains terminal authority

run.compaction.reason: Pi's compaction_start and compaction_end inside a prompt run, threshold and overflow alike, become the run's compaction events; it compacts before agent_settled, so the run is still open

session.compact.reason: a compaction request on an idle session runs Pi's compact command, with focus as its custom instructions; Pi never continues the turn, so continue is refused

session.compaction.policy.reason: set_auto_compaction switches Pi's own threshold on or off, at open and between runs; its threshold is a settings-file reserve, so share and tokens are refused

session.message.delivery.auto.reason: idle auto is normalized to native prompt/start

session.message.delivery.queue.reason: v0.1 admission cannot expose Pi queued prompt semantics safely

session.message.delivery.steer.reason: guidance rides Pi's native steer command and settles at the turn boundary Pi injects it

session.message.submit.reason: successful prompt response proves admission only

session.open.reason: one ready Pi process is associated with one OAP session

session.open.reopen.reason: switch_session loads the bound session file; an absent, empty or mismatched file is refused

session.reasoning.reason: set_thinking_level once the process is ready and again between runs, confirmed by get_state; a level Pi does not run the model at is refused, and a live change restores the level it replaced
